title: Tracking a parcel
content: Use the tracking reference from the dispatch message to track your parcel. A newly created reference may take a day to become available.

title: Resetting a demo account password
content: Choose Reset password on the sign-in page. The demo sends a reset link that expires after fifteen minutes. Never share the link with another person.

title: Changing a delivery address
content: A delivery address can be changed before the parcel is dispatched. After dispatch, contact the carrier to check available delivery options.
